result.title: "The Life Cycle of Software Objects" by Chiang is available for free

contents.markdown: I [recently recommended](/lw/2q7/open_thread_september_2010_part_2/2mov?c=1) this novella. Now you don't need to buy the hardcover or wait for it to be reprinted. You can read it [here](http://subterraneanpress.com/index.php/magazine/fall-2010/fiction-the-lifecycle-of-software-objects-by-ted-chiang/).
